watches.name: Brigade Subcommander - Matte Black
watches.description: Brigade Subcommander No-Date: Mercedes Hands Drawing inspiration from the British Royal Navy's storied history of maritime exploration, the Subcommander is a modern reinterpretation of classic dive watch design. Engineered to exceed the demanding standards of both the British and French navies, it combines vintage allure with state-of-the-art technology. Simple and functional design: This Brigade Subcommander features a date configuration, emphasizing its utilitarian purpose. The matte black dial with luminous hour markers and hands provides excellent legibility in low-light conditions. Durable construction: The 316L stainless steel case and bracelet are built to withstand the rigors of diving, while the unidirectional rotating bezel with its aluminum insert helps divers track elapsed time underwater. Although not as "bright" as the 904L, 316L stainless steel is a harder alloy. Reliable workhorse movement: The Brigade Subcommander was designed to be a daily adventure companion. That is why we paired it with the Swiss Elaboré grade Sellita SW200-2b (adjusted to 3 positions). Renowned for its ruggedness and dependability, the Brigade Subcommander is accurate up to +-7 seconds per day. Timeless appeal: The classic design of the Brigade Subcommander coupled with distinct design elements makes it a desirable watch for both collectors and watch wearers who appreciate its vintage design charm. The Brigade Subcommander is a true icon of watchmaking history, representing the pinnacle of diving watch design and craftsmanship. Master watchmakers from some of the most famous watchmaking "maisons" such as Rolex, Omega and Patek Phillipe have joined our ranks, abandoning the pursuit of over indulging opulence to bring classic designs back to true horology enthusiasts. The combination of their expertise and the rugged durability, functional simplicity, and timeless aesthetics of this design has solidified its place as one of the most sought-after models in history.

Engineered to exceed the demanding standards of both the British and French navies, it combines vintage allure with state-of-the-art technology. Simple and functional design: This Brigade Subcommander features a date configuration, emphasizing its utilitarian purpose. The matte black dial with luminous hour markers and hands provides excellent legibility in low-light conditions. Durable construction: The 316L stainless steel case and bracelet are built to withstand the rigors of diving, while the unidirectional rotating bezel with its aluminum insert helps divers track elapsed time underwater. Although not as "bright" as the 904L, 316L stainless steel is a harder alloy. Reliable workhorse movement: The Brigade Subcommander was designed to be a daily adventure companion. That is why we paired it with the Swiss Elaboré grade Sellita SW200-2b (adjusted to 2 positions). Renowned for its ruggedness and dependability, the Brigade Subcommander is accurate up to +-7 seconds per day. Timeless appeal: The classic design of the Brigade Subcommander coupled with distinct design elements makes it a desirable watch for both collectors and watch wearers who appreciate its vintage design charm. The Brigade Subcommander is a true icon of watchmaking history, representing the pinnacle of diving watch design and craftsmanship. Master watchmakers from some of the most famous watchmaking "maisons" such as Rolex, Omega and Patek Phillipe have joined our ranks, abandoning the pursuit of over indulging opulence to bring classic designs back to true horology enthusiasts. The combination of their expertise and the rugged durability, functional simplicity, and timeless aesthetics of this design has solidified its place as one of the most sought-after models in history. Specifications Movement Swiss Elaboré grade SW200-2b (adjusted to 2 positions). watches.name: Brigade Hurricane - RAF Edition
watches.description: Brigade Hurricane - RAF Launch Edition A Tribute to a Valiant Aircraft - Inspired by the iconic British fighter plane, the Hurricane Pilot's Watch embodies the spirit of aviation with its robust design, precise movements, and elegant aesthetics. The Hawker Hurricane played a crucial role in the Battle of Britain, often overshadowed by its more famous counterpart, the Supermarine Spitfire. However, it was the sheer number of Hurricanes and the bravery of their pilots that ultimately turned the tide of the battle. This edition model pays homage to this often-overlooked hero of the skies as well as the famed American Eagle Squadron. The watch features the Brigade shield prominently displayed on the dial, while the crown is adorned with the iconic Eagle Squadron logo, honoring the American volunteers who joined the RAF before the United States formally entered the war. The watch features a brushed stainless steel case with a polished bezel, creating a rugged yet refined profile. A domed sapphire crystal magnifies the matte black dial, ensuring optimal readability. We use top-grade Super-LumiNova (BGW9) for the watch hands and indices, providing exceptional nighttime legibility. This luminous material emits a brilliant blue glow, enabling pilots to easily read the time during low-light conditions.

watches.name: Brigade Hurricane - Pilot Watch
watches.description: A Tribute to a Valiant Aircraft - Inspired by the iconic British fighter plane, the Hurricane Pilot's Watch embodies the spirit of aviation with its robust design, precise movements, and elegant aesthetics. The Hawker Hurricane played a crucial role in the Battle of Britain, often overshadowed by its more famous counterpart, the Supermarine Spitfire. However, it was the sheer number of Hurricanes and the bravery of their pilots that ultimately turned the tide of the battle. This edition model pays homage to this often-overlooked hero of the skies as well as the famed American Eagle Squadron. The watch features the Brigade shield prominently displayed on the dial, while the crown is adorned with the iconic Eagle Squadron logo, honoring the American volunteers who joined the RAF before the United States formally entered the war. The watch features a brushed stainless steel case with a polished bezel, creating a rugged yet refined profile. A domed sapphire crystal magnifies the matte black dial, ensuring optimal readability. We use top-grade Super-LumiNova (BGW9) for the watch hands and indices, providing exceptional nighttime legibility. This luminous material emits a brilliant blue glow, enabling pilots to easily read the time during low-light conditions. All Hurricane's will start flying on March 31st 2025!
